verification: No complete current-baseline hosted or local act receipt is recorded by this review. Gate definitions and prior scoped evidence are not a PASS for the current tree.

gaps.current: PostgreSQL Hub and production packaging-worker startup install transaction-bound notification intents for the documented pending-review, authority-change, Plan-failure, aborted-promotion and accepted-recall transitions. Source/audit/intent commit together, consent candidates are frozen and current authority is rechecked at admission and external delivery. Restart and lost-ack recovery are bounded by retained intents; no historical backfill, intent-queue metrics/alerts or configured file-store delivery is claimed.

Request metrics, bounded access-log fields, trace identifiers, notification delivery/exhaustion signals, alert rules, dashboard assets and runbooks are merged. Trace identifiers provide log correlation only: no spans are recorded or exported. Alert expressions, dashboard loading, live selectors and thresholds remain unqualified on a running fleet.

Ordered transactional migration ledger, schema verification, populated-data and mixed-version rehearsals exist. Down migrations are intentionally absent. No complete gate or production-capacity result for this baseline is claimed.

A PostgreSQL dump/restore drill, append-only audit chain, verified JSONL export/offline check and opt-in scheduled checkpoint verifier exist. Independent checkpoint custody, deployment backups and secret copies belong to the operator. Deployment execution and capacity remain unestablished. Live-ledger pruning requires a separate accepted archive/expiry design.
Connected recall roll-off exists; disconnected targets do not receive source recall metadata through the Bundle resource set. Installation packaging is not evidence of disconnected fleet operation.

The Release model does not represent the application storage/schema compatibility needed to prove that rollback is safe. Controller storage migration rehearsals do not provide that tenant-application guarantee.
Product-owned SLO monitor resources and their automatic recall policy remain unmodelled. Internal liveness probes and reconciliation metrics are different capabilities.

Namespaced Spoke RBAC, Agent credential inventory/expiry, durable revocation with per-request rechecks and a two-root CA rehearsal are implemented. Cert-manager enrolment, mounted-certificate rotation and target-cluster lifecycle remain unexercised. A bounded threat model, selected control mapping and an uncommissioned external-review brief are merged; independent review, FIPS boundary decisions and exercised tenant authority remain open.

Shape, exact image coverage and scan freshness are enforced, but a fresh supplied assessment is retained without a Hub-witnessed source binding. PR #277 deliberately closed only freshness. External suppression references must not be mistaken for internal Plan approvals; the lost trust-policy remainder is reissued separately.
